items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So this being Grant Williams' home, he decided he's going to stay, and so he joined my band

ctx.x: So this being Grant Williams' home, he decided he's going to stay, and so he joined my band and so the captain at the Tulsa Club--

Bruce Steele was in there, a terrific white band, and when he was leaving and they would pay a band on a week stand. So they had an opening and this head waiter, Johnson--Captain Johnson--the manager said why don't you see how you feel, give them a try, and so this manager of the hotel, he said well, I don't know whether they'll go for it. He said try it anyway. He even told him let him audition, see what you think about him. He said, well you know about it than I do, if you said all right, I'm just wondering how…
